finding.claim: yyyy uses pad(y(),4) without handling negative years, so String(-1).padStart(4,'0') produces '00-1' with the minus sign in the middle instead of a sign-prefixed zero-padded year. yy correctly uses Math.abs but yyyy does not.
finding.title: yyyy token mis-formats negative years

verifier.reason: Confirmed: src/dateformat.js:99 defines yyyy as pad(y(),4) without Math.abs unlike yy at src/dateformat.js:98, and pad at src/dateformat.js:221 is String(val).padStart(len,'0'), so a negative year from getFullYear at src/dateformat.js:65 such as -1 yields '00-1'.
